name: Aizawa Hitomi
source:
The protagonist’s cousin, a female teacher. She comes across as a bit stern with her hair pulled back tightly, glasses, and a tight-fitting suit. She’s what you’d call a “cool beauty.”

She’s in her late 20s, strict with both others and herself, and the protagonist has always felt he couldn’t stand up to her.

That said, she genuinely cares about him; even though she lectures him on all sorts of things, she also has a kind side that shows through when she cooks for him or helps with cleaning.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/212441/]Getchu[/url]]
